metadata.name: Runway Nine
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: An airport at dusk. Flight 9, a widebody jet, stands at gate 9: the jet bridge from the terminal's gate lounge reaches its front door, stair trucks its right front and left rear doors, and ladders from the apron climb onto the wings and the over-wing exits. Inside: the flight deck, business class, two aisles of economy, galleys and lavatories. Around it: the two-storey terminal (baggage make-up, reclaim, check-in, the glass-fronted gate lounge, shops and security), fuel trucks that blow up, baggage carts and tugs, cargo containers, the control tower with a sniper's cab, the maintenance hangar with a business jet, the taxiway and the lit runway. Hostage Rescue: the Hijackers hold four passengers aboard and the Response team brings them out to the lounge or the hangar. Bomb: the flight deck and the mid-cabin galley. Capture the Flag: the reclaim hall against the cabin.

do.text: Runway Nine. Flight 9 is boarding at gate 9: the jet bridge, the stair trucks and the wings lead aboard.
Gate 9: the jet bridge door is locked for 15 s.
